adult_verification_required: Adult verification is required to turn off SAFE mode.
open_failed: Could not open the conversation. Try again.

hint.thumbnail: The picture shown on lists, cards and chat rooms. 1:1, up to 5MB
hint.name: The title shown on cards and lists. 1–30 characters
hint.tagline: Say what the story is in one line. It shows under the title
hint.persona: Give the character's name, gender and age in the story
hint.personality: Describe the character's personality, background and relationships
hint.speech_style: Write speech habits, forms of address and sample lines
hint.world_setting: Write the place, era and rules of the setting
hint.first_message: The first message a user sees when a chat starts. Wrap actions in *asterisks*
hint.status_window_enabled: When on, the AI adds the current state, such as affection, to every reply. When off, it is left out of the prompt
hint.status_window_format: Write it exactly as the status window should look
hint.status_window_initial: Write the values at the start of a chat, following the format. They show under the first message and the AI continues from them
hint.status_window_rules: Write when and by how much the values change
hint.is_adult: When on, only members who passed adult verification and turned adult mode on see it
